sents.text: Mortal Combat three. A quick trip down memory lane.
Nineteen ninety five. The arcade was loud, and you were always out of quarters.
Pick your fighter. Everyone had a main.
Then came the new Run button, and the fights got fast.
Chain a combo, and the whole arcade went wild.
Then the voice said, Finish him! And you tried your best Babality.
Who was your main? Comment below, and follow R G Brick and Stick Verse for more memory lane.
